@supabase/supabase-js 2.117.3
Vendored UMD distribution; MIT license in supabase-LICENSE.
Source: https://github.com/supabase/supabase-js
Only loaded after cloud-config.json has a Supabase URL and publishable key.

marked 18.1.1
ES module from the npm release, SHA-512 integrity checked before vendoring.
MIT license in marked-LICENSE.
Source: https://github.com/markedjs/marked

DOMPurify 3.4.17
ES module from the npm release, SHA-512 integrity checked before vendoring.
Dual licensed MPL-2.0 OR Apache-2.0; license texts in dompurify-LICENSE and dompurify-LICENSE-MPL.
Source: https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify

Markdown is parsed locally with Marked and sanitized with DOMPurify.
Raw HTML and images are inert text; only HTTP(S) links without credentials are clickable.
No external CDN is needed at runtime.
